description: #1050 review rounds 4-5: an unresolved indirect callback in the source function, reachable from a receive, withholds the all-clear with an indirect_call_unchecked leaf, for both call:recv (whose correlated field reload once let it report an all-clear) and arg:recv:1. The control without a callback, and a process-ID system call after the receive (not a function-pointer call), keep the call:recv all-clear; that all-clear carries the receive-family all_clear_caveats.
